messages:
Maya: quick heads-up — NimbleRetail onboarding health looks shaky during peak traffic. p50 ~85ms, p95 ~480ms on chat/generate, token cost ~2.3x expected. Customer flagged latency and cost as renewal risk if we don't improve within 2 weeks. 

Maya: proposed proactive plan: (1) pilot int8 quantized redwood-3b for their chat route (A/B canary: 10% traffic), (2) route high-volume bursts to dedicated eu-west-1 pool, (3) enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts. Need eng + enablement to coordinate. :eyes:

Devon: can run a replay against their prod-ish traces and simulate the A/B. will need prompt set & keys for the route. sample local repro command:```rwinf replay --project nimbleretail --route chat-gen --traces traces/2026-03 --canary-config canary.json```

Devon: also note: int8 usually cuts GPU memory & per-token cost, but watch for token generation divergence. we'll capture eval diffs.

Priya: agree on canary instead of full swap. int4 could be tempting but higher quality risk for their customer prompts (lots of short-context product codes). recommend int8 first. I'll prepare a 200-prompt eval set focused on edge cases.

Kai: I can spin up the canary rollout in Console and create routing rules (10% int8 -> dedicated eu-west, 90% default hosted). I'll include fallback to the default model for any anomaly >2x error rate. tagging runbooks.

perf-bot: automated perf-scan result for suggested canary baseline (simulated): median latency -6%, p95 -18%, token compute cost -28%, sample quality delta (BLEU-like) -0.6% on eval set. (details stored at https://console.redwood.ai/ops/runs/1769994321)

Maya: nice, perf-bot numbers look promising. Action items: @Devon run replay & attach logs here, @Priya publish eval set + quality thresholds, @Kai create canary rollout + doc the routing policy, I'll sync with customer tomorrow 10am CET. Please confirm ETA. :thumbsup:

Devon: on it — replay scheduled tonight, ETA results tomorrow 09:30 CET. I'll include a minimal repro snippet and the `rwinf` command output in this thread.

Priya: eval set ready by EOD, I'll include a small diff harness and threshold recommendations (max 1% quality regression).

Kai: creating rollout now. I'll post the console link and the YAML for the routing policy here once done.

Maya: perfect. if results look good we'll run a 48hr canary and then a phase increase to 30% before a full swap. capturing as renewal mitigation plan. thanks all. :pray:
